newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GUCCI BUYS STAKE IN OWN FRANCHISEE.
newsitem.headline: GUCCI BUYS STAKE IN OWN FRANCHISEE.

text.p: Italian luxury goods maker Gucci Group NV said on Wednesday it had purchased a majority stake in its franchisee Gucci Venezia.
Gucci Venezia, which operates five stores across Italy, had net revenues of some nine million dollars in 1996, Gucci said.
Together with the opening of Gucci's first two stores in China, Gucci will now have 76 directly operated and 77 franchise stores throughout the world, it said.

"We view these initiatives as strategic steps in our efforts to enhance Gucci's worldwide retail presence and gain greater control over our brand image," chief executive officer Domenico De Sole said in a statement.
Gucci Group is based in Florence, Italy, but is registered in the Netherlands. Its shares are listed on the Amsterdam and New York stock exchanges.
